about_the_game:
《Carste Magic》

Description​​

An ​​engine-building​​ focused strategy card game. Craft unique spell combos by chaining elements to power your staff engine, with dynamic progression in every duel.

​​Key Features​​

🌀 ​​Elemental Chaining​​

• Design element sequences to activate staff-bound spells

🃏 ​​Modular Construction​​

• 100+ combinable cards (Staves + Spells)

• Multiple asymmetric starter decks

• Randomized setups per match

⚡ ​​Dynamic Scaling​​

• Smoother chains = More resources → Stronger cards

• Comeback mechanics via Life Track system
